normalization: Available component weights are renormalized when a component is NOT_APPLICABLE or UNKNOWN; missing information reduces confidence and does not silently become zero.
blockerRule: J010 HARD_MISMATCH produces INELIGIBLE and cannot be rescued by fit score.
rationale: Mandatory requirement coverage is the largest component because unsupported blockers must dominate ordinary similarity.
Relevant experience and role/function reuse existing qualification and evidence authorities.
Seniority, domain, and compensation remain unknown or not applicable unless an existing authority supplies them.
Geography/work arrangement is deliberately low-weight and never resolves unresolved preference authority.
promotionStatus: Requires Ross human labels and offline acceptance evidence before any production use.
